outline:
1. Introduction
2. Signals and Spectra
3. Signal Transmission and Filtering
4. Linear CW and Modulation
5. Exponential CW Modulation
6. Sampling and Pulse Modulation
schedule:
1. Introduction:(第一週-第二週)
(1). Elements and Limitations of Communications Systems
(2). Modulation and Coding

2. Signals and Spectra:(第三週-第六週)
(1). Line Spectra and Fourier Series
(2). Fourier Transforms and Continuous Spectra
(3). Time and Frequency Relations

3. Signal Transmission and Filtering:(第七週-第九週)
(1). Response of LTI Systems
(2). Signal Distortion in Transmission
(3). Filters and Filtering
(4). Correlation and Spectral Density

4. Linear CW and Modulation:(第十週-第十三週)
(1). DSB-LC/DSB-SC
(2). SSB/VSB
(3). Frequency Conversion and Demodulation

5. Exponential CW Modulation:(第十四週-第十六週)
(1).Phase and Frequency Modulation
(2).Transmission Bandwidth and Distortion
(3). Generation and Detection of FM and PM

6. Sampling and Pulse Modulation:(第十七週-第十八週)
(1).	Sampling Theory
(2).	PAM/PDM/PPM
assessment:
1. 期中考、平時考、期末考與作業。
2. 出席率。
materials:
【遵守智慧財產權觀念，請使用正版教科書，不得使用非法影印教科書】

Communication Systems, 4/e, A. B. Carlson, Paul B. crilly, and Janet C. Rutledge, McGraw-Hill, 2002
